reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies a precise intervention, controlled comparison, measurable outcomes, and extends prior W-alloying evidence to an Al-free CoCrFeNi matrix and a full temperature sweep. Its claimed oxide-glaze mechanism—especially at room temperature—is insufficiently supported, but A provides no prior evidence and assumes h-BN remains chemically stable and forms a continuous lubricating film in air at 800 °C, which is doubtful.
